name: Mistral AI MCP
tagline: Use Mistral models, embeddings, and OCR from chat.
shortDescription: The Mistral AI MCP server. Run any Mistral model (Mistral Large, Codestral, Pixtral), generate embeddings, run OCR, and use function calling. The OpenAI-compatible alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Mistral's official MCP server. Exposes the Mistral API as MCP tools: chat completions with any Mistral model (Large, Small, Codestral, Pixtral), embeddings, OCR, and function calling. OpenAI-compatible API.

## Why we recommend it

Mistral is the strongest European open-weights LLM provider. The MCP server makes it as easy to use as OpenAI — and the Codestral model is excellent for code generation.

## When to use it

- Code generation: agent uses Codestral for code completion
- Vision: agent uses Pixtral to analyze images
- Embeddings: agent generates embeddings for RAG
- OCR: agent extracts text from PDFs and images
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://console.mistral.ai
2. Set `MISTRAL_API_KEY=...`
3. `npx -y @mistralai/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Mistral: pay per token. Free tier for experimentation.
